conditions.bounded_adaptation: No cellar or deep trench; separate shallow stepped plinths rather than whole-frontage platform.
conditions.minimum_closure: Review exact load/influence volume, ground contact and known artificial-content protections before foundation freeze. Do not treat shallow no-air evidence as deep clearance.
conditions.closed_parts: Actual edit/contact volume and bounded screening coverage; no below-ground edits, known artificial positions not directly intersected
conditions.minimum_gap: Justify load/influence depth and lateral extent; verify bearing/ground discontinuities and relevant artificial structure extent. No blanket full geology request.

conditions.minimum_closure: Confirm household design occupancy; finalize door privacy/weathering, ventilation, flue and fire separation, native railing/screen collision. Two-bed study is not evidence of actual household size.
conditions.closed_parts: 2-resident design scenario, separate work/family/yard, fixed sleeping/cooking/hygiene/storage spaces; doors/screens and static routes
conditions.minimum_gap: Functional flue and fire/heat separation; validate ventilation/privacy/weathering and native interactions as required for final design; actual population not asserted.

conditions.minimum_closure: Explicit target/revision/hash authorization, land-use and common-easement agreement. This task requests no construction.
Actual clean-water source/quality/capacity, food/fuel delivery cadence, reserve and interruption response. Palette does not prove materials supply.
Waste destination/responsibility, closed carrying containers, clean/dirty time separation, and one-batch handheld work limit. No throughput claim.
Compile selected native block states, roof flashing/gutters, chimney lumen and doors; recheck supports, stairs and route collision. Custom review boxes are not an executable Canonical Blueprint.
conditions.closed_parts: Explicit native doors/stairs/slabs/guards/screens/beds/roof/support states; static movement checked
conditions.minimum_gap: Flue lumen, roof flashing and connected collection/retention details remain uncompiled; native interaction/update behavior unverified. Solid chimney is not valid translation of a flue.

conditions.minimum_closure: Design and prove parcel-local collection/retention/recovery/safe failure; or return new UPSTREAM_PLANNING_ISSUE if infeasible.
conditions.closed_parts: No-discharge/public-no-receiver responsibility inherited; original and larger local storage options assessed
conditions.minimum_gap: Justified cumulative design/failure envelope and proved local recovery; if infeasible, smallest explicit rainwater service revision, never assumed public outfall.

conditions.minimum_closure: Consume BDP-01 r3 and prove design fidelity to revised public and rainwater baselines; no gate result assigned by Planner.
conditions.closed_parts: All requested r3 fidelity dimensions explicitly reviewed
conditions.minimum_gap: Rainwater issue and Builder-owned blockers prevent freeze; no semantic PASS inferred from geometric checks.
